title: Chris Godwin, Yaya Diaby among Buccaneers out of practice Wednesday

sources.name: Pro Football Talk
sources.title: Chris Godwin, Yaya Diaby among Buccaneers out of practice Wednesday
sources.description: The Buccaneers know they won't have quarterback Baker Mayfield against the Packers this Sunday and they were missing a number of other players at practice on Wednesday.
